issue_context.title: Custom Facebook Ads Operator
issue_context.body:
**Description**
This is feature request to have custom operators to pull insights from Facebook Ads Platform

- This enables facebook ads as a platform to be integrated into airflow by enabling operators
- The initial request would provide Ad Insights from facebook

**Use case / motivation**
- The operator is QA - verified by strong test case policy of the community
- Continuous support by the open source development community
- Pulling FB Ad insights can then be then used for data viz. and biz. decisions
